recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not duplicate the already-published FHIR-15154 audit; handle any future attester/authenticator expansion under its own Jira issue.
issue_request: FHIR-12289 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core Composition change request asking to include RelatedPerson as an allowed reference target for Composition.attester.party for authorized representative, guardian, parent, or power-of-attorney attestation use cases.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite svn revision 13104. That revision maps to git commit 04fb3079bd44513f51cffc189ec0828259a77715, which changed the historical Composition spreadsheet row for Composition.attester.party from Reference(Patient|Practitioner|PractitionerRole|Organization) to Reference(Patient|RelatedPerson|Practitioner|PractitionerRole|Organization).
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml preserves RelatedPerson in Composition.attester.party. The same-change-family STU3 issue FHIR-15154 has already been audited on the combined branch, and community searches found no Confluence reference or later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already implements the requested RelatedPerson target and no in-scope parallel source location was inconsistent.
